e.title: Agentic Insurance Claims (AWS)
e.summary: AWS 官方 agentic 理赔方案：六专长 agent（身份核验/文档抽取/保单校验/欺诈检测/裁决）多代理理赔处理
e.body:
Insurance Claims Processing — Agentic AI Solution 是 AWS 官方示例：用 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 做多代理编排加速寿险身故理赔处理——六个专长 agent 分别负责身份核验、文档抽取、保单校验、欺诈检测与裁决。对 RIAA：保险多代理 agentic AI 的官方参考架构（身份/文档/保单/欺诈/裁决全链路）。与 [[claimpilot-harness]]（评测）、[[mongodb-insurance-agentic]]（MongoDB agent）、[[agentic-bop-underwriting]]（核保 agent）互补。关联 [[ms-claims-automation-accelerator]]、[[actuarial-skills]]。

e.summary_en: Official AWS agentic claims solution: six specialist agents (identity verification/document extraction/policy validation/fraud detection/adjudication) for multi-agent claims processing
e.summary_hk: AWS 官方 agentic 理賠方案：六專長 agent（身份核驗/文檔抽取/保單校驗/欺詐檢測/裁決）多代理理賠處理
e.body_en:
Insurance Claims Processing — Agentic AI Solution is an official AWS sample: multi-agent orchestration with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to accelerate life-insurance death-benefits claims — six specialist agents handle identity verification, document extraction, policy validation, fraud detection and adjudication. For RIAA: the official reference architecture for insurance multi-agent agentic AI (identity/document/policy/fraud/adjudication full chain). Complements [[claimpilot-harness]] (evaluation), [[mongodb-insurance-agentic]] (MongoDB agent) and [[agentic-bop-underwriting]] (underwriting agent). Related: [[ms-claims-automation-accelerator]], [[actuarial-skills]].
